title: pyrus nummularia
intro: Pyrus nummularia, commonly known as the Chinese pear, is a deciduous tree species native to China. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus nummularia include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
